sarah (runtime PM): quick sync — trying to lock owners + blockers for fastpath instrumentation + KV prefetch telemetry. target: canary next week. who owns the kernel CRs, infra toggle, and perf validation?

omar (kernel): i can own the kernel changes (microbatch hotpath + counters). blocker: eng-infra PR that updates base image & libtorch (see PR #4321). also need platform review for rollout hooks.

omar (kernel): CR is ~6 files, ~120 LOC. adding counters/histograms for fastpath hits, kv hit/miss, latency buckets. prom labels: model, seq_len. ETA: CR by EOD tomorrow. :eyes:

omar (kernel): diff snippet:```diff
--- a/kernel/instrumentation.cc
+++ b/kernel/instrumentation.cc
@@ -120,6 +120,9 @@
+  metrics.increment("fastpath_hits");
+  metrics.observe_histogram("kv_lookup_latency_ms", ms);
```

jen (platform): we can enable the rollout in ~48h once feature flag exists. need the flag name + rollout policy. sample config:```yaml
feature_flag: fastpath_instrumentation
rollout:
  region: us-west-2
  percent: 10
```

kevin (qa): i'll assemble perf matrix + baseline 95p lat. what endpoints + models should i target? will need a couple of sample traces to reproduce.

sarah (runtime PM): omar — can you drop the CR link + small description in this thread when it's open? also: are alerts needed for kv miss rate or p95 growth? who owns those?

omar (kernel): will post CR link. alerts: add kv_miss_rate and fastpath_p95. kernel team owns metric defs; platform to own alert policies.

ci-bot: build status for PR #7123 — unit & lint passed, integration: 1/3 pending.

jen (platform): @gwen can you prioritize infra PR? we need base image bump & runtime lib on infra side to match kernel.
gwen (eng-infra): i'll pick up PR #4321 tomorrow morning, ETA midday. note: libtorch bump has a flaky test on p4s — i'll run quick smoke.
omar (kernel): ok i'll split docker/base image change into a tiny separate PR to unblock infra. opening that in the next hour.
sarah (runtime PM): ownership summary so far: omar = kernel CR & metrics, jen = rollout toggles & canary config, gwen = infra image PR. kevin = perf validation. any objections? :thumbsup:
kevin (qa): +1
jen (platform): +1
omar (kernel): +1 — also requesting security review from @dave to confirm no PII leakage from counters.
dave (security): quick note — counters must not contain PII. add scrub label if you emit any input-derived strings. i'll review the CR tomorrow.
sarah (runtime PM): thanks all — i'll update the ticket + Notion milestone. target: canary start Monday 10:00 PT. fallback: Wed if infra slips. i'll paste CR links here when available.
ci-bot: deploy checklist snapshot -> infra_ready=false, kernel_cr=opened, perf_matrix=queued
sarah (runtime PM): action items: 1) omar: open kernel CR + docker split PR (by EOD tomorrow) 2) gwen: infra PR triage (tomorrow AM) 3) jen: prep feature flag + rollout YAML (48h) 4) kevin: perf harness matrix (on CR open). i'll follow up in ticket.
omar (kernel): noted — will post links shortly.
gwen (eng-infra): i'll update here when smoke tests finish.
kevin (qa): standing by to run perf jobs once CRs land.
sarah (runtime PM): thanks everyone — small follow-ups in the ticket.
